before.name: Stevie Wilson
before.description: Stevie Wilson, also known as Stephen Wilson, is a Black queer abolitionist writer and organizer. While imprisoned at SCI Fayette in Pennsylvania, he wrote in support of Rikers Island hunger strikers seeking protection from COVID-19. Prison officials intercepted his electronic message and issued a misconduct report. Following an April 7, 2020 disciplinary hearing, he received 30 days in solitary confinement and began a hunger strike against the punishment. He later described spending a month in solitary for the writing. This case concerns that disciplinary confinement; his original criminal imprisonment is a separate matter. In a July 2026 firsthand essay, Wilson reported completing his underlying sentence and leaving prison on February 9, 2026.
